dataset_name: ALG26 code and image upload test set
purpose: Supplemental real files for testing code ingestion and image OCR ingestion in the knowledge-base assistant.

files.expected_summary: Python implementation of KMP prefix-function preprocessing and pattern search. It demonstrates fallback through pi[j-1] and linear-time matching.
good_questions: 这段代码里的 compute_pi 函数是做什么的？
为什么 KMP 搜索时文本指针不需要回退？
kmp_search 找到一次匹配后为什么把 j 设为 pi[j-1]？

files.expected_summary: Python snippets comparing Dijkstra and Bellman-Ford. Dijkstra rejects negative edge weights, while Bellman-Ford supports negative edges and detects negative cycles.
good_questions: 这段代码为什么在 Dijkstra 中检查 weight < 0？
Bellman-Ford 如何检测负权环？
有负权边但没有负权环时应该用哪个函数？

files.expected_summary: Red-black tree insert-fixup outline with the five properties and three common fixup cases, but no complete code.
good_questions: 红黑树插入修复中叔父节点为红色时怎么处理？
这份资料是否给出了完整红黑树插入修复代码？
叔父为黑色时为什么可能需要先旋转一次？

expected_ocr_text_contains: Bellman-Ford: negative edges, detects negative cycles
Max flow: Edmonds-Karp O(VE^2), Dinic O(V^2E)
